svg.title: Candidate cost scores: hierarchical matching, recursive shrinkage, and historical standard error
svg.desc: Historical feedback and the current state determine the finest sufficiently supported group. Group statistics are recursively shrunk toward parent risk using a support-dependent weight. The selected group's shrunk loss plus beta times historical standard error yields the cost score for Static, ACI, AgACI, EnbPI-RH, TSC, and EEE.

g.aria-label: Finest group with n greater than or equal to n minimum
